candidates.change_summary: Delete the require-revert that gatekeeps on initialized, so SetMinSum can be called at any time, changing MinSum after initialization.
Remove the if-initialized-revert guard, so SetMinSum always updates MinSum regardless of initialization state.
Replace the revert with a no-op so that when initialized is true the function silently ignores the new value instead of reverting, leaving MinSum unchanged in that scenario.
Drop the whole if check, making a single unconditional assignment to MinSum.
Remove the initialization guard so MinSum can be changed multiple times.
Assign a constant value to MinSum instead of the parameter.
Replace the initialization check `if(intitalized)revert();` with `if(!intitalized)revert();` so that SetLogFile can only be called before Initialized instead of after.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` statement so that SetLogFile can be called at any time, allowing subsequent calls to change the LogFile address.

Replace 'acc.balance += msg.value;' with 'acc.balance += msg.value + 1;' to make the balance increase by one more wei than the sent amount, changing the observable Put behavior via public mapping Acc.

Replace 'if(block.timestamp+_lockTime>acc.unlockTime)acc.unlockTime=block.timestamp+_lockTime;' with 'acc.unlockTime=block.timestamp+_lockTime;' to always update unlockTime regardless of the current value, changing the observable unlockTime in the public mapping Acc.
Delete 'acc.balance += msg.value;' so the balance is not updated but the event is still logged, directly changing the balance observable via the public mapping Acc.
Delete the require statement so that overflow in balance is not prevented, allowing balance to wrap around and change observable behavior via the public Acc mapping.

Replace 'LogFile.AddMessage(msg.sender,msg.value,"Put");' with 'LogFile.AddMessage(msg.sender,0,"Put");' so the logged value in the event is always zero, changing the externally readable LastMsg.Val and History entries.

Replace 'if(block.timestamp+_lockTime>acc.unlockTime)acc.unlockTime=block.timestamp+_lockTime;' with 'if(block.timestamp+_lockTime<=acc.unlockTime)acc.unlockTime=block.timestamp+_lockTime;' to invert the condition, changing unlockTime updates and observable behavior via public Acc.
